driver.name: StockPlannerDriver
driver.responsibility: Break down incoming goals into sub-tasks and assign them to specialized worker agents.

workers.name: market-news-collector
workers.responsibility: Collect live or fallback market news and macro context relevant to the target stock.

workers.name: company-performance-agent
workers.responsibility: Review the company’s 5-year performance, strategic plans, and forward-looking drivers without hardcoding a specific stock.

workers.name: chart-analyzer
workers.responsibility: Assess price structure, momentum, support/resistance, and trend quality.

workers.name: market-sentiment-analyzer
workers.responsibility: Interpret market mood, volatility regime, and broader sentiment trends.

workers.name: history-analyzer
workers.responsibility: Review historical performance, market regimes, and decision patterns.

workers.name: fundamental-agent
workers.responsibility: Assess business quality, valuation, and earnings quality.

workers.name: technical-agent
workers.responsibility: Assess technical setup and timing quality.

workers.name: risk-sentiment-agent
workers.responsibility: Validate risk posture before the decision can proceed.

workers.name: debate-controller
workers.responsibility: Compare arguments and surface the strongest evidence.

workers.name: master-agent
workers.responsibility: Decide whether the task passes, reduces, or vetoes the trade.

workers.name: execution-agent
workers.responsibility: Prepare the broker-safe execution route and order plan.

workers.name: stage-build-sequence
workers.responsibility: Map work into milestone-based build stages and rollout sequence.

workers.name: environment-checks
workers.responsibility: Validate environment readiness, dependencies, infrastructure, and configuration.

workers.name: paper-trading
workers.responsibility: Validate order flow and risk logic in a paper-trading environment.

workers.name: shadow-mode
workers.responsibility: Test live-data decisions without placing real orders.

workers.name: live-mode
workers.responsibility: Prepare and monitor a safe production rollout.

workers.name: observability-and-logs
workers.responsibility: Ensure health checks, alerts, logs, and observability remain active.

workers.name: model-diversity-checks
workers.responsibility: Confirm independent model usage and provider diversity.
